craft_notes: Sthāyin: turn-joy. kālāgnimāditaḥ fused. Close: body. Rejected: 'soul' — killed: body kept.

lines: Rite-blind, rule-wise, he turns to worship's art —
time-fire made first, through māyā's end, in brahma-body.
l4.sanskrit_cite: avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati kālāgnimāditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntaṃ brahmadehagam |

reads_against.argmap: Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns toward worship — time-fire to brahma-body.
c1_essence: Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns; time-fire to brahma-body.
